description: As compliant, but key info reports an empty IP allowlist.

expected.outcome: Refused (check: allowlist present) with an allowlist rule in every environment; not persisted; the copy says the allowlist is set in the Bybit dashboard (TC-104). On a stored key switched to it, the start-up self-check (TC-128) and the hourly one (TC-132b) flag only that account: it is disabled by policy with the reason shown and an alert raised, the other accounts stay verified, and the system is read-only (cancel and flatten still work).
